indexes.name: classrooms_id_organization_id_owner_account_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX classrooms_id_organization_id_owner_account_id_key ON device_management.classrooms USING btree (id, organization_id, owner_account_id)

indexes.name: classrooms_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX classrooms_pkey ON device_management.classrooms USING btree (id)

indexes.name: device_commands_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_commands_pkey ON device_management.device_commands USING btree (id)

indexes.name: device_commands_poll
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX device_commands_poll ON device_management.device_commands USING btree (device_id, state, id)

constraints.name: device_commands_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying, 'acknowledged'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: device_credentials_credential_hash_key

indexes.name: device_credentials_device
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX device_credentials_device ON device_management.device_credentials USING btree (device_id) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: device_credentials_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_credentials_pkey ON device_management.device_credentials USING btree (id)

indexes.name: device_enrollments_code_hash_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_enrollments_code_hash_key ON device_management.device_enrollments USING btree (code_hash)

indexes.name: device_enrollments_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_enrollments_pkey ON device_management.device_enrollments USING btree (id)

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX device_events_device ON device_management.device_events USING btree (device_id, id)

indexes.name: device_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_events_pkey ON device_management.device_events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: device_heartbeats_pkey

indexes.name: device_sessions_active
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_sessions_active ON device_management.device_sessions USING btree (device_id) WHERE ((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['CLOSED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[]))

indexes.name: device_sessions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_sessions_pkey ON device_management.device_sessions USING btree (id)

constraints.name: device_sessions_desired_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (desired_status IS NULL OR (desired_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['AUTHORIZED'::character varying, 'PREPARING'::character varying, 'WINDOWS_PROFILE_READY'::character varying, 'SYNCING_IN'::character varying, 'ACTIVE'::character varying, 'ENDING'::character varying, 'SYNCING_OUT'::character varying, 'STORAGE_CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'CLEANUP'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying, 'SYNC_PENDING'::character varying, 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[])))

constraints.name: device_sessions_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['AUTHORIZED'::character varying, 'PREPARING'::character varying, 'WINDOWS_PROFILE_READY'::character varying, 'SYNCING_IN'::character varying, 'ACTIVE'::character varying, 'ENDING'::character varying, 'SYNCING_OUT'::character varying, 'STORAGE_CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'CLEANUP'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying, 'SYNC_PENDING'::character varying, 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: devices_id_organization_id_owner_account_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_id_organization_id_owner_account_id_key ON device_management.devices USING btree (id, organization_id, owner_account_id)

indexes.name: devices_owner
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX devices_owner ON device_management.devices USING btree (organization_id, owner_account_id, created_at, id)

indexes.name: devices_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_pkey ON device_management.devices USING btree (id)

constraints.name: devices_classroom_id_organization_id_owner_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (classroom_id, organization_id, owner_account_id) REFERENCES device_management.classrooms(id, organization_id, owner_account_id)

constraints.name: devices_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['OFFLINE'::character varying, 'AVAILABLE'::character varying, 'RESERVED'::character varying, 'PREPARING'::character varying, 'SYNCING_IN'::character varying, 'ACTIVE'::character varying, 'SYNCING_OUT'::character varying, 'CLEANUP'::character varying, 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'::character varying, 'ERROR'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: module_migrations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX module_migrations_pkey ON device_management.module_migrations USING btree (name)

indexes.name: workstations_classroom_id_number_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workstations_classroom_id_number_key ON device_management.workstations USING btree (classroom_id, number)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workstations_pkey ON device_management.workstations USING btree (id)
